referrals.intro: Most of our patients come from someone who already had their smile done here. If a friend or family member is thinking about veneers, a smile design or full mouth restoration, send us their name and we take it from there: a free photo evaluation, a written estimate within 6 hours, and a $500 credit toward your own treatment once theirs is completed.
referrals.formIntro: Tell us who to contact and how. We only reach out once, and only to the person you refer.
referrals.messagePlaceholder: Their name, how to reach them, and what they are interested in.

points.d: For every person you refer who completes their treatment, you receive a $500 credit toward your own treatment. Add your own name in the form so we know who sent them.
Your friend sends two photos; a doctor replies with a plan and a written estimate within 6 hours.
Referred patients get the published packages and the 5-year written warranty like everyone else.
Three visits in one week in Miami, with hotels, airport pickup and rides handled by the coordinator.

bonus.title: $500 per completed treatment
bonus.text: For every person you refer who completes their treatment, you receive a $500 credit toward your own treatment. Add your name and contact details in the form so we know who sent them.

partnerships.intro: Xiluet Smiles works with general dentists, specialists, clinics abroad, and travel and hospitality businesses in Miami. If your patients or clients could use a smile design, porcelain veneers, full mouth restoration or All-on-X, tell us about your practice or business and a doctor will follow up.
partnerships.formTitle: Tell us about your practice or business
partnerships.formIntro: A short message is enough. We reply within a few hours during office hours, in English or Spanish.
partnerships.messagePlaceholder: Who you are, where you are based, and how you would like to work together.

points.d: Refer cosmetic and full-arch cases to a team with an in-house lab; your patient returns to you for ongoing care.
Patients fly in Monday and fly home Thursday with their final veneers. Planning happens from home before the trip.
Hotels, concierges and medical travel agencies: our coordinator handles dates, pickup and rides for every out-of-state patient.
